method: Read complete extension script and metadata; checked accepted parent files against metadata and prior independent QA.
Viewed native closed-locked frame, 12x lock engagement close-up, five-frame nearest preview and GIF initial frame; decoded all GIF frames for exact pixel and duration checks.
Reran unchanged extension script in a temporary copied tree; all 13 PNG/GIF outputs match byte for byte.
Independently composited the saved same 8x3 bolt at x56 and x61 over fixed floor/under fixed cover; retracted frame equals prior frame_00 exactly.
visual_findings: The extended bolt visibly bridges the gap to the dark keeper recess; the retracted pose clears the keeper, then the accepted three inward-open poses follow.
The housing and frame are stable. The difference strip is limited to the sliding bolt path.
The same complete bolt is translated; its tail is partially occluded under the unchanged housing cover in the retracted state, rather than shortening the bolt geometry.
limits: The six colored pixels inside the recess establish a 2D drawing relationship only, not verified socket depth, physical contact, tolerances or functional lock hardware.

Expected bolt engagement overlaps the keeper lip/recess region. This exception must not be generalized into a claim that all locked moving hardware has zero wall/keeper overlap. The wooden leaf geometry itself remains unchanged.
Five sampled states, with no intermediate bolt translation or continuous swept-volume validation.
GIF jumps from fully open to locked at loop reset; reverse closing/locking is not implemented.
No engine integration, collision-grid, game-scale or gameplay validation; opening/unlocking does not establish rescue, consent, survival, evidence or rewards.
